description: Booking.com hotel price guide for a city (e.g. fr / paris): the lowest 'from' nightly price in the page title and Booking.com's published average nightly prices for 3-, 4- and 5-star hotels (typical, this weekend, tonight, as stated on the city page), plus the hotels Booking.com names as best or popular with their URLs. Currency selectable. Averages are Booking.com's own figures, not a live date search. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

city.description: City as in Booking.com city URLs, e.g. paris, new-york, rome

country.description: Two-letter country code as in Booking.com city URLs, e.g. us, fr, gb

name: travel_booking_com
title: Travel Booking Com
